facts.fact: 故意绊人进罚席——他享受看那混蛋摔倒；当年当 enforcer 的外号正是 Monster Max
facts.anchor: I was known for my fights, but usually it was because my coach wanted me to be the enforcer: Monster Max.

facts.fact: 进球后做 spin，Flora 没笑反而瞪他，他笑得更开
facts.anchor: She’s not cheering—she’s not even smiling, and for some reason, that makes me grin wider.

facts.fact: Flora 兴师问罪：说漏夜宿+头痛，让 Clouds 夫妇以为他们有问题
facts.anchor: You told Jem I stayed at the cookery school overnight and that I’ve had headaches.

facts.fact: 他替她摘下发圈、卷起袖子，把号码写在手臂上
facts.anchor: I slowly remove the hairband from around her fingers.

facts.fact: 私人烘焙课的目的：Bailey 因为她开始聊天、愿意走出壳
facts.anchor: It was nice to see him smile and come out of his shell.

facts.fact: 交易：每周一堂课换整骨疗程——他自认付不起但「愿意付最后一分钱」
facts.anchor: I can’t afford it, but I’ll make it work. I’d pay my last cent

facts.fact: Henry 冲来报信：Max 家着火了——小的，Bailey 没事
facts.anchor: There’s been a fire at your house.

facts.fact: 临走扔下一句：把你的想法全发短信给我
facts.anchor: Text me your thoughts, all of them!
